notes.title: Free Demo Released!
notes.notes:
Kiss Upload is the second PC game by Roxiano Creations, planned to come out in 2021. It’s a choice-based visual novel set 96 years in the future where the player can experience different story lines full of action and romance. The demo is now released! You may download it from the Kiss Upload main page.

The free demo includes the origin of Tobias, the player character, as he embarks into the time travel experiment of a lifetime. The plan is to emerge from cryostasis 500 years into the future. However, something goes wrong – He gets out much earlier than expected. With no way to re-enter the pod, and no peep from the Sci-Max facility who began the experiment, Tobias is left with nothing. Just when it can’t get any worse, his first chance encounter faces him with the most dangerous kiss he thought he’d ever have – a data-transfer from a robot girl named Vi. Government conspiracy and corporate overlords entangle him on his journey to undo the kiss. What will become of Tobias then?

Upon beginning the demo, the player will be fully-introduced to the first goal of the game, and can even make a major path-branching choice. Tobias will choose to work with a suspicious FBI pair, or with a rogue engineer. Either option is expanded into the second chapter of the story, making the play-time worth the download. At the end of the demo, you may choose to begin again with a different path, or visit the store page. Don’t forget to add Kiss Upload to your wishlist!
